definitions.explanation: The young, edible shoot of a bamboo plant. A prized spring ingredient in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{筍|たけのこ}が{旬|しゅん}を{迎|むか}える。
examples.english: Bamboo shoots come into season when spring arrives.

examples.japanese: {採|と}れたての{筍|たけのこ}を{米|こめ}ぬかで{茹|ゆ}でてアクを{抜|ぬ}いた。
examples.english: I boiled the freshly harvested bamboo shoots with rice bran to remove the bitterness.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana as たけのこ or in kanji as {筍|たけのこ}. The kanji {竹|たけ}の{子|こ} (literally "child of bamboo") is also seen but less common than the single-character form.

USAGE:
{筍|たけのこ} is a quintessential spring ingredient in Japan. Fresh shoots require preparation — they must be boiled with {米|こめ}ぬか (rice bran) or {米|こめ}のとぎ{汁|じる} (rice washing water) to remove their astringent flavor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筍|たけのこ}ご{飯|はん}: bamboo shoot rice
- {筍|たけのこ}の{煮物|にもの}: simmered bamboo shoots
- {筍|たけのこ}{掘|ほ}り: bamboo shoot digging
- {筍|たけのこ}の{土佐煮|とさに}: bamboo shoots simmered in bonito-flavored broth
